P&G's operating income fell about 3.4% from fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2026.

Figures from the fiscal 2026 10-K:
- Fiscal 2026 operating income was $19,748 million.
- Fiscal 2025 operating income was $20,451 million.
- The change is $19,748M − $20,451M = −$703M, which is −703 / 20,451 ≈ −3.44%.

The company's own filing rounds this to a 3% decrease.
